You will work across business, engineering, architecture and operations teams to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, governed and production\-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.

  



Success in this role requires a proven ability to architect, build and operate secure, resilient and highly available enterprise products at scale while driving innovation, operational excellence and enterprise adoption of AI\-powered solutions.

* Own the end\-to\-end architecture vision, standards and technical strategy for enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions.

* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity management, privacy, governance and Responsible AI principles.

* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, lead complex initiatives and mentor high\-performing engineering teams.

**Ideally, you'll also**


* Bring strong hands\-on experience with .NET / C\# and enterprise application architecture.

* Have experience with Microsoft Foundry or comparable enterprise AI development, governance and operations platforms.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** Cosysta  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala / Hybrid  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Role:** Leadership – Technology \& Product Engineering

About Cosysta

Cosysta is a technology company focused on building modern software products, AI\-enabled solutions, digital transformation platforms, web applications, mobile applications, and custom technology solutions for clients in India and international markets.

We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** who can take complete ownership of Cosysta’s technology function and build a scalable engineering organisation.

Role Overview

The CTO will be responsible for the overall technology strategy, software architecture, engineering quality, product development, technical delivery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology team development at Cosysta.

This is not purely a management position. The CTO should be capable of reviewing architecture, solving difficult technical problems, guiding developers, interacting with clients, estimating projects, and ensuring successful delivery.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnology Strategy \& Leadership

* Define and execute Cosysta’s long\-term technology roadmap.
* Select appropriate technologies, platforms, frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and development standards.
* Ensure technology decisions support scalability, security, performance, profitability, and business growth.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, cloud computing, SaaS, and modern application development.
* Work closely with the CEO, CMO, CFO, and other leadership members on company strategy.

Software \& Product Architecture

* Design and review scalable software architectures.
* Lead architecture decisions for web, mobile, SaaS, enterprise, AI and cloud\-based applications.
* Establish coding standards, development practices and documentation standards.
* Conduct technical reviews of critical projects.
* Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability of products.

AI \& Emerging Technologies

* Lead the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into Cosysta products and client solutions.
* Evaluate LLMs, AI APIs, RAG systems, AI agents, automation tools and related technologies.
* Identify commercially viable AI products and services.
* Ensure responsible, secure and cost\-efficient implementation of AI systems.

Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and manage a high\-performing technology team.
* Recruit developers, technical leads, AI engineers, QA engineers and DevOps professionals as required.
* Mentor junior and senior developers.
* Conduct technical interviews and skill evaluations.
* Define individual and team KPIs.
* Establish accountability for quality, timelines and delivery.

Project \& Client Delivery

* Take technical ownership of major client projects.
* Participate in technical discussions with clients.
* Convert business requirements into appropriate technical solutions.
* Support project estimation, timelines and resource planning.
* Identify technical risks before project commencement.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed scope, quality and deadlines.
* Support the sales team during technical presentations and proposal discussions.

Development \& Quality Assurance

* Establish development workflows including:
* Git and version\-control standards
* Code reviews
* CI/CD
* Automated testing
* QA processes
* Release management
* Documentation
* Monitor application performance and reliability.
* Ensure proper testing before production releases.
* Implement processes to minimise bugs and production failures.

Cloud, Infrastructure \& DevOps

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and deployment architecture.
* Manage or supervise platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel or equivalent infrastructure.
* Improve deployment automation and infrastructure efficiency.
* Monitor infrastructure and cloud expenditure.
* Establish backup, disaster recovery and business\-continuity procedures.

Cybersecurity \& Data Protection

* Establish security standards for Cosysta and client projects.
* Ensure secure coding practices.
* Protect company source code, intellectual property and customer data.
* Implement access\-control and credential\-management policies.
* Ensure appropriate security reviews for production systems.
* Support compliance requirements where relevant.

Technology Operations

* Maintain proper documentation for all major technology systems.
* Ensure company repositories, domains, hosting, cloud accounts, APIs and technology assets remain under proper organisational control.
* Maintain technology vendor relationships.
* Introduce tools and automation that improve developer productivity.

Expected Technology Exposure

The ideal candidate should have strong experience across several of the following areas:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Python
* REST APIs
* Modern databases
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* MongoDB or NoSQL technologies
* Cloud infrastructure
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Vercel
* Docker
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* SaaS architecture
* Mobile application development
* AI/ML integration
* LLM APIs
* RAG and AI\-agent architecture
* Cybersecurity
* DevOps
* System design and scalable architecture

The CTO is not expected to personally code every project but must possess enough technical depth to **review, challenge, guide and take responsibility for technical decisions**.

Required Experience

* Preferably **8\+ years of software development / technology experience**.
* Strong experience in software architecture and engineering leadership.
* Previous experience leading developers or technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering commercial software projects.
* Strong understanding of modern web and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making ability.

Experience in a startup, software services company, SaaS company or product\-development organisation will be highly valuable.

Preferred Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are hands\-on technology leaders rather than purely administrative managers.
* Can build a technology department from an early stage.
* Understand both software engineering and business requirements.
* Are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical clients.
* Have experience working with international customers.
* Understand project cost, engineering productivity and commercial viability.
* Can create reusable technology frameworks rather than rebuilding everything from scratch.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured through areas such as:

* On\-time technology delivery
* Project quality
* Reduction in production bugs
* Development productivity
* Technology\-team performance
* Architecture quality
* System uptime and reliability
* Infrastructure cost optimisation
* Client satisfaction on technical delivery
* Security and compliance
* Successful implementation of AI capabilities
* Development of reusable technology assets and products

First 90\-Day Expectations

During the first three months, the CTO will be expected to:

* Conduct a complete audit of existing Cosysta technologies, source code, infrastructure and active projects.
* Review the technical capabilities of the existing development team.
* Establish coding, Git, QA, documentation and deployment standards.
* Prepare Cosysta's technology roadmap.
* Identify critical technology risks.
* Recommend the required engineering team structure.
* Improve project estimation and technical delivery systems.
* Establish security, backup and access\-control procedures.
* Develop an AI integration roadmap for Cosysta products and services.
* Build a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting international expansion.

Reporting Structure

The CTO will be part of the **Core Leadership Team of Cosysta** and will work closely with:

* Chief Executive Officer / Managing Leadership
* Chief Marketing Officer
* Chief Financial Officer
* Operations / Project Management Team

The CTO will have authority over the company's engineering, technical architecture, development standards and technology\-delivery functions.

Ideal Candidate

Cosysta needs a **builder CTO** — someone who can move comfortably between boardroom discussions, client meetings, system architecture, code reviews and engineering\-team mentoring.

The objective is not simply to manage developers, but to build a **high\-quality, scalable and commercially strong technology organisation capable of serving international clients and developing Cosysta's own technology products**.

Pay: ₹21,772\.93 \- ₹70,116\.86 per month

Work Location: In person

Assistant Director \| Enterprise Technology

  


**The opportunity**



In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.

  



The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.

* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.
* Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore.
* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches.
* Strong scripting and automation skills, including:
	+ Python
	+ PowerShell
	+ Bash / Shell scripting
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).

* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**


* ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) — enterprise\-scale deployment and administration. 7\+ years.
* APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7\+ years.
* Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7\+ years.
* Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7\+ years.
* Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5–7 years.
* Kibana dashboard and visualization development. 5–7 years.
* Index lifecycle management (ILM), hot\-warm\-cold architecture and data tiering. 5–7 years.
* Log parsing, grok pattern development and field enrichment. 5–7 years.
* Metrics collection frameworks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, StatsD or equivalent).
* Distributed tracing — implementation, instrumentation and analysis.
* Alert management and notification workflows across monitoring platforms.
* SIEM integration and security event log forwarding.
* TLS/SSL configuration and security hardening of ELK components.
* Role\-based access control (RBAC) within Elasticsearch and Kibana.
* Containerized deployment of ELK components (Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift).
* CI/CD pipeline integration for monitoring\-as\-code and configuration management.

* Performance troubleshooting of high\-ingestion Elasticsearch clusters (50 GB\+/day).
* Onboarding application and infrastructure teams onto APM and logging platforms.
* Windows and Linux systems administration supporting ELK infrastructure.

  


**Ideally, you'll also have**


* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Dynatrace Associate or Professional certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Administrator or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging).
* Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment.

  


**What we look for**



An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SB - 1506 -Team Lead – Infrastructure Engineering
description:
Position: Team Lead – Infrastructure Engineering
Department: Infrastructure \& Security Operations (Infra \& SecOps)
Location: Kochi, Kerala \- Work from office **Role Summary**
Softobiz is establishing a centralized Infrastructure \& SecOps function to move project delivery streams away from manual cloud configurations toward a modern, self\-service Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Product model. As Team Lead – Infrastructure Engineering, you will lead this transformation on the ground by authoring production\-grade Terraform golden modules, establishing automated CI/CD provisioning pipelines, and embedding ISO 27001 compliance guardrails. Operating in a hands\-on player\-coach capacity from our Kochi office, you will directly build scalable multi\-cloud infrastructure while mentoring platform engineers and shaping our core engineering baselines.**Key Responsibilities****Infrastructure Architecture \& Golden Modules*** **Design, build, and maintain** reusable Terraform golden modules across AWS and Azure for core infrastructure patterns, including VPC/networking, compute, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), databases, IAM, and storage.
* **Define and enforce** enterprise governance baselines across AWS Organizations and Azure Management Groups, including standardized resource naming, landing zone architecture, and mandatory tagging structures.
* **Write and maintain** thorough, developer\-friendly technical documentation and runbooks for every infrastructure module and pipeline stage to ensure seamless adoption by project teams.

**CI/CD Provisioning \& Shift\-Left Security*** **Own the end\-to\-end provisioning pipeline** by combining golden modules, automated security scanning, and policy gates into unified CI/CD workflows (GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions).
* **Embed security controls and guardrails** directly into pipelines using static code analysis (tfsec, Checkov), Policy\-as\-Code frameworks (OPA, Sentinel), and secrets management to ensure resources are secure by default.
* **Partner with Cloud Security Engineers and the CISO's office** to align infrastructure controls with ISO 27001:2022 Annex A requirements and maintain versioned, audit\-ready compliance trails.
* **Review infrastructure change requests** and pull requests submitted by engineering teams to enforce standards around security, modularity, and cloud cost optimization before production deployment.

**Team Leadership \& Capability Building*** **Build and scale the Infrastructure team** as a founding member, initially operating in a player\-coach capacity (0–2 direct reports) and expanding as organizational demands grow.
* **Mentor platform and DevOps engineers,** establish engineering best practices, lead sprint planning, conduct code reviews, and act as an escalation lead for infrastructure operational issues.

**Required Technical Skills****Domain** **Skills \& Technologies** **Must / Preferred**  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Terraform (modular design, state management, module registries) **Must\-Have**  


Cloud Platforms AWS (VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, CloudTrail) and Microsoft Azure (VNets, AKS, Management Groups, Key Vault) **Must\-Have**  


Cloud Platforms Google Cloud Platform (GCP) **Good\-to\-have**  


Containers \& Orchestration Kubernetes architecture, EKS, AKS, Docker containerization **Must\-Have**  


CI/CD \& Automation GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines **Must\-Have**  


Policy as Code \& Security Scanning tfsec, Checkov, Open Policy Agent (OPA), HashiCorp Sentinel, Trivy **Must\-Have**  


Security \& Compliance ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls implementation, Secrets Management (Vault/Key Vault) **Must\-Have**  


Scripting \& Tooling Bash, Python, or Go for automation scripting **Preferred** **Qualifications \& Certifications*** **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:** 8–11 years of hands\-on experience in Systems, Cloud, and Infrastructure Engineering, with at least 2\+ years leading engineers, designing landing zones, or architecting multi\-cloud foundations.
* **Compliance Exposure:** Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining infrastructure environments aligned to formal frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST).

**Preferred Certifications:*** HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or DevOps Engineer – Professional
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or DevOps Engineer Expert

**Soft Skills \& Cultural Fit*** **Strong Ownership \& Builder Mindset:** Proven ability to build greenfield infrastructure processes and operate independently in an evolving, high\-growth environment.
* **Cross\-Functional Communication:** Exceptional ability to translate complex cloud governance, security, and infrastructure concepts to application teams, delivery managers, and executive stakeholders.
* **Mentorship \& Leadership:** Passion for coaching team members, conducting constructive pull request reviews, and fostering a culture of operational excellence.
* **Cross\-Timezone Collaboration:** Ability to collaborate seamlessly across distributed global teams spanning India, the US, and Australia.

**What We Offer*** **Strategic Impact:** Greenfield opportunity to architect and shape the core multi\-cloud infrastructure and security standards across the entire enterprise.
* **Global Exposure:** Work alongside enterprise clients and cross\-functional engineering teams across India, Australia, and the US.
* **Leadership Trajectory:** Direct pathway to grow and lead a dedicated Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering team.
* **Continuous Learning:** Comprehensive support for advanced cloud architecture, security, and IaC certifications.
